title: Check & Mate
author: Ali Hazelwood
summary: Mallory, a former child chess prodigy, now works in an unrelated field, while rival Nolan, her old nemesis, has become a champion. A long-ago game still stands between them.
readIf: you like banter-led, rivals-to-lovers romance with a competitive hobby at its centre.
skipIf: you want deeper character study or a plot that goes beyond the romance.
